name: OBIS API
summary: Marine species occurrence records, taxonomy, datasets and statistics from the Ocean Biodiversity Information System.
description: OBIS integrates marine biodiversity observations from thousands of datasets worldwide. The v3 API serves occurrence records (filterable by taxon, area, date and depth), taxon lookups, checklists, dataset metadata, and quality-control statistics. Occurrence queries use after-id paging for deep results.

endpoints.summary: Occurrence records (flattened event and occurrence fields)
Taxon records by AphiaID or name
Species checklist for an area or taxon
Published datasets with citations and licences

example.response_excerpt: {"total":126378,"results":[{"datasetName":"Observatoire Pelagis - Reseau National Echouage (French stranding network) strandings 1934-2020","decimalLatitude":49.18,"decimalLongitude":-1.601,"eventDate":"2000-02-19","scientificName":"Delphinus delphis"}]}

license.name: Mostly CC BY 4.0; some datasets CC BY-NC, CC BY-NC-ND or CC BY-SA

agent_notes: Request only the columns you need with fields; whole records are large. Page deep results with after (the id of the last record) rather than offset. Taxon ids are WoRMS AphiaIDs. Check each dataset's licence before commercial use.
caveats: Licences differ per dataset (CC BY-NC appears), so commercial use depends on the dataset.
The occurrence endpoint reports totals above 258 million records at check time but caps size per request.

verification.notes: Exact example executed without a key; taxon, checklist, dataset and statistics endpoints also answered 200.
